name: Anaya's Pendant
summary: Across Ameth'Aran, Anaya's Pendant remains with the restless ghost of Anaya Dawnrunner. Cerellean Whiteclaw carries grief for the love he lost when the Sundering shattered their world.

sections.title: A Keepsake Across Millennia
sections.body: When the Well of Eternity was destroyed ten thousand years ago, the ancient kaldorei city of Ameth'Aran fell into ruin. Cerellean Whiteclaw believed his beloved Anaya had perished, and carried his grief into a long sleep beside Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage. After waking, he wandered Darkshore and found Anaya's tormented apparition still drifting through Ameth'Aran, bearing the pendant. Cerellean cannot raise a hand against her himself, so he asks travelers to free her spirit and recover the heirloom.

sections.title: Parting and Peace
sections.body: In Auberdine, Cerellean receives the pendant, and Anaya Dawnrunner's spirit briefly appears before him one last time. Freed from the anguish binding her to Ameth'Aran's haunted ruins, her ghost fades peacefully into the night. Cerellean is left alone with the pendant and the memory of their ancient love.

faq.q: Where does Anaya's Pendant come from?
aliases: how do i get anaya pendant
faq.answer: Anaya's Pendant comes from the ghost of Anaya Dawnrunner, who wanders the ancient kaldorei ruins of Ameth'Aran in southern Darkshore.

aliases: who do i give anayas pendant to
faq.answer: Cerellean Whiteclaw wants Anaya's Pendant. He is a grieving night elf who lives in Auberdine, the coastal town in Darkshore.

faq.q: Why couldn't Cerellean retrieve the pendant himself?
faq.answer: Cerellean found his lost love's spirit roaming Ameth'Aran, but could not bear to raise his own hand against her, even after ten thousand years of sorrow.

faq.q: What happens when you return the pendant to Cerellean?
faq.answer: When you return the pendant to Cerellean in Auberdine, Anaya's spirit briefly appears to bid farewell, then fades into peace. Cerellean is left to grieve her memory.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see in the pendant a reminder of the War of the Ancients and the many lives and loves torn apart in the Great Sundering.
As a druid, you know Cerellean slept for millennia beside Shan'do Stormrage, hoping to escape his grief, only to wake to ghosts lingering in the waking world.
